# Claid.ai

Claid.ai offers AI-powered image editing APIs for tasks like background removal, upscaling, and color correction.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/claid-ai/.

## Actions

- **CLAID Background Remove**: Remove the background from images.
- **CLAID Image Edit Batch**: Process multiple images in batch.
- **CLAID License Plate Blur**: Blur license plates in images to meet privacy requirements.
- **CLAID Smart Frame**: Smart-frame images.
- **Connect New Storage**: Connect a storage resource.
- **Generate AI Backgrounds**: Generate AI backgrounds for a product image.
- **Generate Images from Text**: Generate images from text prompts.
- **Generative Resize Image**: Adjust image aspect ratios via generative outpainting.
- **Get Storage Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a connected storage resource.
- **Image AI Edit Async**: Submit an asynchronous AI-based image editing task.
- **List Connected Storages** (read-only): List connected storage resources.
- **List Storage Types** (read-only): Retrieve available storage types.
- **Polish Image**: Remove AI artifacts via polish restoration.
- **Update Connected Storage**: Update a connected storage's settings.
- **AI Photoshoot**: Transform product shots into model photoshoots.
